title: Emergency stop mushroom head push-button - 22 mm (cap and collar excerpt)
creator: Henrique Enzweiler
origin: Center of black collar rear mounting face
axis: Positive Z points out of the machine panel toward the operator; X/Y lie in the panel plane.
adaptations: Tessellated original BRep at 0.08 mm chordal / 0.15 rad angular tolerance; extracted original red cap and dark collar faces; omitted source yellow enclosure and electrical housing; rigidly transformed axes and origin. Original visible cap/collar shape is unscaled. Planar disks were added only at hidden circular material-interface openings to make each extracted component watertight.
deviations_from_photo: Generic community CAD geometry, not an identified manufacturer match to the photographed UTM.
No white twist-release markings or fine perimeter grip ribs are modeled.
Photo has a yellow rectangular upper/lower protective guard; this source instead has a yellow enclosure, omitted from extracted button.
40 mm cap diameter and 24.0204 mm outward projection are source CAD dimensions, not measurements of the photographed machine.
